notes: Card: peaks on the token just before remplacées/replaced/replacement in French, Russian and code; output promotes '-re', 'unre', 'reset'. Probe: 'will gradually be' 0.48 whether the next word was replaced or repainted, so the neuron reads the context, not the word; 'was replaced as manager' 0.03.
